Fixture Instruments

Fixture Instruments has made precision tuning forks in Pune, India since 1974. Every fork is machined from a single billet of aluminium alloy and calibrated against a reference standard before it leaves the workshop.

What we make

We make tuning forks in the range A-220 to A-880, in quarter-tone steps, for laboratory calibration, instrument manufacture and audiology clinics. Each fork is supplied with its measured frequency at 20 degrees Celsius.

Where to find us

Our workshop is at 12 Laburnum Road, Pune 411001, Maharashtra, India. We are open Monday to Friday, 9am to 5pm India Standard Time.
